settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: General settings — Account / Notify / Schedule / Platform (admin)

banner.pre: You are an admin — platform LLM configs / user grants / quotas live in the

lang.title: 🌐 Language / 语言
lang.label: UI language
lang.desc: Applies immediately; the preference is stored in this browser.

common.copyFailedManual: Copy failed, please select and copy manually

userProfile.title: 🪪 User identity (agent view)
userProfile.badge: Account-level · injected into all future agent task contexts
userProfile.bioHint: (empty = omitted; who you are, preferences, taboos, etc.)
userProfile.bioPlaceholder: e.g. Call me Lao Wang; prefer terse reports; give conclusions directly in tech talks…
userProfile.aside: The agent receives this identity at the start of every task session (once per session, not repeated per turn). Inspired by OpenClaw USER.md's "About Your Human". When unset, the agent defaults to "User".
userProfile.savedWithNickname: Saved — the agent will call you "{name}"

preflight.title: ⚡ Preflight check
preflight.label: Enable preflight check (recommended)
preflight.aside: When enabled, tasks run an environment check (git/Node/dependencies) before starting, reducing failures.

git.title: 🌿 Git commit identity
git.badge: Account-level · applies to git commits of all future tasks
git.aside: Author/committer identity for git commits made by agent subprocesses (visible in git log). Injected via environment variables, without touching each repo's .git/config. Empty falls back to account email + email prefix.
git.errNameChars: Git name cannot contain < > or newlines
git.savedWith: Saved — agent commits will be signed {name} <{email}>

toolApproval.label: Tool approval
toolApproval.desc: when the agent requests a tool permission

userDialog.label: User dialog
userDialog.desc: when the agent asks you a question

reviewing.label: Enter review
reviewing.desc: when a task enters the reviewing state

paused.label: Paused (auto)
paused.desc: when the agent auto-pauses a task

queued.label: Queued
queued.desc: when a task enters the queue

fork.title: 🔀 Fork auto-compact threshold
fork.aside: When the fork dialog opens, "compact and continue" is auto-checked if the parent task's context exceeds this value.

media.title: 🎨 Media API key (mmx-cli)
media.desc: Used to call the minimax media platform (mmx-cli) in tasks to generate images/videos/music etc. The credential is stored encrypted in the database and picked up by agent processes on next start.
media.decryptFail: ⚠️ Stored key failed to decrypt (usually an ENCRYPTION_KEY change). Please re-enter it.
media.deleteConfirm: Delete the media API key config? Agent tasks will no longer be able to generate images/videos/music via mmx-cli.

token.title: 🔑 API Token
token.desc1: Non-expiring personal access token. CLIs / scripts call all endpoints with
token.createdTitle: Token created (shown once — copy it now)
token.warn: ⚠️ Tokens never expire. Deleting only removes the record; a token stays valid server-side until JWT_SECRET is rotated.
token.createdMsg: ✅ Token created (shown in plaintext only once)
token.deleteConfirm: Delete token "{name}"? The JWT stays valid until JWT_SECRET is rotated.
token.batchDeleteConfirmSwitch: Delete {n} tokens? This includes switch-account (it will be recreated automatically on next login).

llm.title: 🤖 Personal LLM configs
llm.desc: Configure multiple LLM configs (e.g. prod / test / Volcano Ark). Tasks/templates pick from "visible LLM configs"; granted platform configs appear here too.
llm.granted: ✅ You have been granted access to platform LLM configs by an admin. Once revoked, only your own configs work.
llm.thCoefTitle: Cost coefficient relative to the platform baseline model (admins set the baseline in platform LLM configs; only configs with prices can compute one)
llm.copyTextTitle: Copy this config as text to the clipboard
llm.catalogHint: Built-in catalog of {count} China-based providers (model lists updated daily at {date}). Picking one auto-fills the Base URL — you only need the key.
llm.namePlaceholder: e.g. Claude prod / Volcano Ark test
llm.modelPlaceholder: Pick or type a custom model name
llm.keyKeepPlaceholder: Leave empty to keep current key
llm.visionHint: Image tasks auto-switch to a vision-capable model on the chain (only when this config is explicitly marked as "no vision")
llm.priceLabel: Unit prices (USD / M tokens, R239 precise billing)
llm.priceHint: Empty = not set. Once any tier is set, task cost is precisely computed from this config's prices (cost_source=priced) instead of the platform average; the platform proxy does not return cache-write prices, so that tier is excluded.
llm.fallbackLabel: Fallback chain (on primary failure switch in order; click to add)
llm.availableTitle: Visible LLM configs (tasks/templates can pick from here)
llm.deleteConfirm: Delete "{name}"? After deletion it falls back to the platform default LLM config.

notify.title: 📧 Notification email
notify.notSet: Not set — notifications go to the system email
notify.smtpWarn: ⚠️ The platform has no SMTP configured (set SMTP_HOST / SMTP_USER / SMTP_PASS / NOTIFY_FROM), so notification emails cannot be sent even if set.
notify.testTitle: Sends to the currently saved address (not unsaved input)
notify.testAsidePre: The test email goes to the
notify.testAsidePost: address — save the input first before testing.
notify.clearedTo: Cleared — notifications go to the system email
notify.sentOk: Sent to {to}{fallback}, please check. SMTP response: {resp}

feishu.title: 🤖 Feishu bot
feishu.msgTypeAside: Old webhooks silently reject markdown (code:10208); use text or post
feishu.testTitle: Sends directly to the webhook in the input (no need to save first)
feishu.aside: "Send test message" sends directly to the webhook in the input (no need to save first) — click "Save" to persist after it works. To get a webhook: Feishu group → Settings → Group bots → Add bot → Custom bot.
feishu.errUrl: Invalid webhook URL (must start with https://open.feishu.cn/hook/)
feishu.parseFail: Failed to parse post.content JSON, check the textarea — use the 2-D array format [[{'{'}tag,text{'}'},{'{'}tag:"a",text,href{'}'},...], ...]
feishu.sentOk: Sent to {to}, please check. HTTP status: {status}

sched.title: ⚙️ Scheduler parameters
sched.badge: Readable by all, writable by admins
sched.timeoutAside: Running tasks keep the timeout resolved at their start; changing the global value does not re-arm their timers.
sched.portPoolAside: Changing the port pool does not migrate ports already in use by projects.
sched.minSegments: Port pool needs at least 1 segment
sched.maxSegments: Port pool allows at most {max} segments, currently {cur}
sched.segInvalid: Port pool segment {idx} invalid: needs {lo}-{hi} integers with start≤end
sched.portFormatInvalid: Invalid port segment format (each segment: integers with start ≤ end)

myQuota.title: 📊 Account quota
myQuota.desc: Your account is marked as Party A by an admin; the R88 trio (spend cap / granted cap / expiry) blocks task creation when hit.
myQuota.hint: Spend details and blocking notices are shown when creating/starting tasks. Contact an admin to adjust.

sysApi.title: 🌐 System API config (env vars)
sysApi.hint: ⚠️ The API key in env vars is only a system-level fallback; regular users must configure their own API key or be granted access by an admin to run tasks.

maint.title: 🔧 Maintenance mode
maint.desc: Graceful shutdown for deploys: pause scheduling, suspend running tasks (context kept, full conversation resumable after restart), dequeue pending tasks. Restarting the service directly kills agent subprocesses too — running tasks lose their context.
maint.exitConfirm: Exit maintenance mode? Suspended tasks will resume automatically.

quotaAdmin.title: 💰 Account quotas
quotaAdmin.desc: Only users marked as Party A (party_a_enabled=1) are blocked by the R88 trio. granted_cap is display-only and not enforced.

adminLlm.title: 🤖 Platform LLM configs
adminLlm.desc: Tasks / templates pick from "visible LLM configs". Granted users can also see these admin configs.
adminLlm.baselineHint: "Baseline" = the denominator model of cost coefficients: click "Set baseline" on a row, and other configs' coefficient = this row's baseline price (in+out) ÷ that row's baseline price. One baseline platform-wide.
adminLlm.coefTitle: Cost coefficient relative to the baseline model = this config (in+out) ÷ baseline (in+out); shows — if no baseline or no prices
adminLlm.setBaselineTitle: Set this config as the cost-coefficient baseline (other configs' coefficients are computed relative to it)
adminLlm.clearBaselineTitle: Clear the cost baseline (all coefficients show —)
adminLlm.priceHint: Once any tier is set, tasks using this config are billed precisely from its prices (no platform average); coefficient = (input+output price) ÷ baseline model's same sum — pick the baseline with "Set baseline" above.

grants.title: 👥 User grants
grants.desc: Grant users access to platform LLM configs, with a per-account concurrency cap (empty = unlimited, still bounded by the global gate). Admins have access by default.
grants.concurrencyInvalid: Concurrency cap must be an integer 1-10, empty = unlimited

roles.title: 🎭 Role presets
roles.emptyDesc: A role = a reusable system_prompt + default-params package; pick one when dispatching to run the task with a preset persona and constraints. Click "New role" at the top right to start.
roles.aside: Global roles are selectable by all projects; project-bound roles only appear in that project's dispatch role dropdown. Tasks of "writeback forbidden" roles do not auto-sync to Feishu (behavior switch; the agent's direct-write channel is unaffected).
roles.phDesc: One line describing what this role does
roles.phPrompt: Role persona / constraints / output requirements. Prepended to the task prompt as a [role: name] prefix at creation.
roles.writebackLabel: Allow Feishu writeback (auto-sync results to the bound sheet on completion)
roles.confirmDelete: Delete role "{name}"? Existing tasks are unaffected (roles are frozen into tasks at dispatch).

channels.title: 📡 Channel intake
channels.badge: IM channel → bound project → intake task
channels.emptyDesc: A channel = one IM bot instance (e.g. a Telegram bot). Bind a project and optionally a default role; external users messaging the bot create tasks in that project. Click "New channel" at the top right to start.
channels.aside: External users message the bot "bind <code>" to complete session binding; afterwards their messages create tasks directly in the bound project (first task gets the default role). Disabled channels do not respond to binds or new messages. Click a bind code to copy it.
channels.lblRole: Default role (mounted on first intake task, optional)
channels.enabledLabel: Enabled (when off, ignores binds and new messages)
channels.typeHintEdit: Channel type decides the consumer protocol and cannot be changed after creation.
channels.typeHintNew: telegram / wecom / feishu are all integrated; openclaw is an internal thread channel, not configured here.
channels.weixinHint: For weixin channels prefer "WeChat QR login" at the top to write credentials automatically; manual format: {'{'}"bot_token":"...","ilink_bot_id":"..."{'}'} or a bare bot_token.
channels.versionHint: When set, demands arriving via this channel land in the selected version; unset = the project's current version.
channels.roleHint: Available set = global roles + the bound project's own roles; if the configured role is not available after switching the bound project, it is kept with a notice.
channels.wxFormHint: Scan with your personal WeChat and the platform creates a weixin channel row (credential stored encrypted).
channels.bindInstruction: Send the bot the following message from this WeChat to finish binding:
channels.wxScanPrompt: Scan with WeChat and confirm login
channels.wxScanned: Scanned on phone — confirm login in WeChat
channels.wxError: WeChat service error, will keep retrying
channels.errRequired: Name and bound project are required
channels.errSecretRequired: New channels need a secret (bot token etc.)
channels.confirmDelete: Delete channel "{name}"? Bind code {code} becomes invalid; existing conversation history is kept.
